stage: Research; saved head_on_13 fixture only; no 36-episode dispatch
hypothesis: Atomic admission of immutable queue + one main control slice + a continuously held executable backup repairs the saved failure without per-node recourse.

arms.B: unchanged finite search and timeout brake
arms.C0: commit-point certificate, discarded after admission; rejection/timeout brakes
arms.C1: same certificate; persist and execute reserve on rejection/timeout

library: unchanged brake or eight .5 m/s compass targets for 1.4 s, brake, analytic CV safe rest; unchanged padded checker
validity: exact ideal-CV model; 1e-7 numerical state/observation tolerance, 0.15 s maximum source age; immutable queue must match certified controls; no robustness claim
injection: 80 ms response availability every sixth absolute control slot (slot % 6 == 5); busy planner skips next slot for all arms. C1 executor still ticks at 20 Hz. Injection is delivery/worker unavailability, not extra CPU cost. Native measured latency >80 ms is never clipped.
measurement: native proposal IPC + reserve IPC + validity + transaction/command preparation measured together; trace serialization and evaluator physics excluded. Injected availability and intrinsic compute distributions both retained. Independent executor is a discrete-event model, not OS real-time validation.

gate.completion: unchanged 40 s absolute timeout, goal radius .15 m and 3 s observation
gate.persistence: no invalid certificate execution, no unvalidated postponement, exact immutable queue; injected miss cannot replace valid reserve with timeout brake

attribution: log proposal, admitted command, candidate/active backup, replacement/rejection, actual execution, planner and validator timing. C0/C1 share checker; C0 deliberately discards certificates and has no executable reserve.
repetition: initial six runs B/C0/C1 x normal/late, one unchanged confirmation after implementation audit; failures stop expansion without tuning library/beam/horizon
interpretation: Go-to-36 requires all gates plus reproducible mechanism attribution; safe but bounded transaction defect is Modify; repeated safety/persistence/intrinsic deadline failure is Stop. Injected deadline misses are expected disturbances and never reported as zero.
data: raw traces/logs/build external; only source, protocol, lightweight summary, manifest, report and optional small plot in Git
